results.name: Moon jellies debut from two vents in Level 5 wave 2 with their hint, and vents come back only in L5 W6, W8 and W9
The first jelly leaves its vent at foe time 2.0 at (110, 400), then rises exactly 40 px a pulse and sways back to the middle
A guardian can place a jelly or a glowworm mid-fight with make and place, and each starts moving at once
A credited seed slides off a jelly in its thrust (jelly:guard) and blooms it in the glide; a Bee Line blooms it in either
A jelly nobody catches bursts at y <= 70 into three glowdrops of one group, which fall and cost one life together
A burst shifts its glowdrops off pieces in the way, and skips a drop with no room
A vent holds the wave open until its last jelly is out, and on an empty board the next jelly comes within a second
A piece parked on a vent mouth makes it wait, and the vent sends its jelly within .3 s of the mouth clearing
A Lullaby freezes a jelly and the vents, and both carry on after
A jelly never costs a life, even one that starts below the line
The jellies, their vents and their bursts play out the same at 30, 60 and 144 FPS
The bot forecasts a jelly exactly (a Lullaby included), shoots only for its glide, and plays the jelly waves
Glowworms debut in Level 5 wave 3 with their hint, five pieces each, and come back in L5 W4, W7, W8 and W9
L5 W4: the worm keeps 21 / 20 px along its track, and its first turn reaches x 64 and comes back 26 px lower
A credited head hit ripples the light down the body: four credited blooms, .07 s apart, all done within .35 s
A credited bead hit snaps the worm: the beads behind become their own worm, the first one its head, paused .3 s
Uncredited strikes, powers on a bead and the ripple links never split a worm; an earned chain does
A Lullaby freezes a worm (sinking too), and each worm group that reaches the line costs one life
A worm and its split play out the same at 30, 60 and 144 FPS
The bot forecasts a worm on its track, goes for heads and leaves beads, and plays the worm waves
The jelly, its vents and glowdrops and the glowworm draw cheaply: finite, balanced, and no gradient, shadow or surface once warm
The jelly shows a different face in its thrust and its glide, with Animations on and off
foes.js never touches the seed pod and never uses Math.random
